name: MolView.org
tierReason: MolView.org focuses on 3D visualization, and its basic sketcher lacks reaction mechanisms, custom styles and SVG export for publication document work.
summary: A browser-based tool for sketching molecules, exploring chemical databases and visualizing structures in 3D.

license.text: Public source code; redistribution requires written permission. Generated content may be used commercially.

engine.rendering: HTML canvas 2D through MolPad; GLmol and ChemDoodle WebGL viewers, with JSmol as another 3D renderer.
engine.chemistry: Ketcher chemical utilities; JSmol calculations; NCI/CADD Chemical Identifier Resolver web service.

caveats: Legacy app is deprecated and receives only critical bug fixes.
Structure images export as PNG; SVG export, reaction mechanisms and custom styles are unavailable.
The newer MolView at molview.com has separate features and pricing.
